trends.name: Iran-US Military Escalation & Market Impact
trends.summary: Iranian missiles struck Prince Sultan Air Base in Saudi Arabia wounding U.S. service members; Houthi group threatens intervention in Red Sea shipping lanes controlling Bab al-Mandab Strait. $5 trillion wiped from US stock market since conflict began, with Wall Street expecting further pain ahead as negotiation outcomes remain uncertain.

trends.name: Market Correction Accelerating Across Indices
trends.summary: S&P 500 down 6.7% YTD with longest losing streak since 2022; Nasdaq 100 in correction territory down 1.9%; more than half of S&P 500 sectors in correction. VIX sustained above 25 for 4 consecutive weeks—longest streak since 2022—signaling elevated volatility expectations.

trends.name: Volatility Spike & VIX Elevation
trends.summary: VIX has closed above 25 for 4 consecutive weeks marking the longest streak since 2022. SVIX analysis suggests bulk of initial spike is behind us, but sustained elevation indicates market pricing in continued downside risk from geopolitical and macro headwinds.

trends.name: Tech Sector Selloff & AI Narrative Shift
trends.summary: Tech stocks suffered worst week in nearly a year with Microsoft oversold at decade-lows amid concern about losing AI leadership narrative. Cybersecurity stocks falling on Anthropic's powerful new model testing. Tech weakness driven by geopolitical risks, Meta legal liability, and AI competition concerns.

trends.name: US Inflation Rising with Fed on Sidelines
trends.summary: U.S. inflation rising amid energy price spikes while Federal Reserve remains in wait-and-see mode. Consumer sentiment plunged 6% due to energy costs and market volatility. Economic forecasts weakening as stagflation risks increase from geopolitical supply shocks.

trends.name: Bond Market Crisis & Rate Spike Risk
trends.summary: Trump has ~50 hours to contain bond market volatility before Sunday futures open; benchmark bonds fell sharply. Wall Street trading positions suggest worst pain from Iran war may still be ahead. Credit markets shifting from risk-on to risk-off amid geopolitical escalation and inflation fears.

trends.name: Strait of Hormuz & Energy Supply Threat
trends.summary: Houthis control Bab al-Mandab Strait and threaten intervention if Red Sea used for attacks on Iran; UAE/Saudi Arabia say ready to absorb escalation but reject post-war Iran controlling Strait of Hormuz. Critical chokepoint for ~6% of global oil supplies facing significant disruption risk.

trends.name: US-Iran Diplomatic Negotiations in Flux
trends.summary: US Envoy Witkoff says Iran's response to 15-point proposal expected; meetings anticipated this week with Trump seeking peace deal. Qatar, Oman, Kuwait pushing for swift resolution while regional powers have divergent interests. Outcome uncertainty keeping markets on edge.

trends.name: Government Shutdown Impact on Markets
trends.summary: TSA funding crisis continues with House GOP spiking DHS funding proposal, extending shutdown causing airport delays. TSA officers expected to receive paychecks by Monday but operational disruptions create economic headwinds and investor uncertainty.

trends.name: Mega-Cap Growth Valuations Under Pressure
trends.summary: High-quality growth ETFs like SCHG facing significant short-term risks despite excellent long-term characteristics. PayPal positioned as possible convexity play while Microsoft and other mega-caps correcting sharply. Valuation compression underway as growth premium evaporates.

trends.name: Wealth Concentration & Boomer Asset Transfer
trends.summary: Baby Boomers (1946-1964) hold $88 trillion in household wealth representing roughly 50% of all US wealth. Upcoming multi-generational wealth transfer and inheritance dynamics creating long-term structural market implications amid current volatility.

trends.name: Nike & Consumer Discretionary Earnings Pressure
trends.summary: Nike needs to return to mid-single-digit revenue growth amid inventory normalization. Consumer discretionary sector facing headwinds from reduced consumer confidence and geopolitical uncertainty, with earnings season revealing demand weakness.
